transactions.property_name: MOB Specialist Clinics, Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia Portfolio: strata units and carpark lots)
transactions.counterparty: Pantai Medical Centre Sdn. Bhd. (wholly owned subsidiary of IHH Healthcare Berhad, a substantial unitholder of the REIT)
transactions.sale_price_citation: full.md line 5160: 'On 21 April 2025, the Group entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Pantai Medical Centre Sdn. Bhd. for the divestment of the entire Malaysia Portfolio for a total sale consideration of RM20.1 million (approximately $6.1 million).'
transactions.citation: full.md line 320: 'The sale price represents a 25.6% premium over the original purchase price and 4.6% above the average of latest valuations of RM 19.2 million (approximately S$5.8 million), which were derived using the income approach in accordance with local valuation standards.'
transactions.currency_mismatch_fix: 2026-08-03: reference_value/reference_currency changed from SGD 5,800,000 to MYR 19,200,000 (local-currency figure) to match sale_price's MYR currency, per full.md line 320: 'the average of latest valuations of RM 19.2 million (approximately S$5.8 million)'. Both the sale price (RM20.1m) and the valuation (RM19.2m) are disclosed in MYR in the same sentence; the S$5.8m is the AR's own parenthetical SGD conversion and is no longer used as the basis so gain math is not a cross-currency subtraction.
transactions.notes: MULTIPLE PERCENTAGES DISCLOSED for this single deal, per assignment care note: (1) 4.6% above the average of latest valuations RM19.2m/S$5.8m -- used here as the primary row (reference_basis=valuation, disclosed) since it is the standard valuation-basis comparable to other rows in this dataset; (2) 25.6% premium over the ORIGINAL PURCHASE PRICE (reference_basis=purchase_price, rare disclosure per spec, but not used as primary row here -- recorded for completeness: pct=25.6, basis=purchase_price, reference_value/currency not separately disclosed in RM or SGD terms in the narrative); (3) audited financial statements independently derive a THIRD figure: net gain on disposal S$123k against carrying value (book value) S$5,863k = 2.10% (reference_basis=book_value, pct_source=derived; carrying value derived as net_sale_proceeds S$5,986k - gain S$123k = S$5,863k, Note 4 Investment Properties p189 and cash flow statement). Sale consideration RM20.1m (~S$6.1m gross); net sale proceeds (incl. divestment costs) S$5,986k per cash flow statement. Divestment accounted for only 0.2% of portfolio value and marked PLife REIT's full exit from Malaysia. Manager commentary (25.6%/4.6%) is narrative, not part of the audited financial statements, but IS a disclosed AR statement so pct_source=disclosed for the primary row.
